---
title: "Downloads"
subtitle: "The accounts in Excel, in English, French and Arabic"
toc: false
---

The three language versions of each workbook hold the same numbers; only labels change, and Arabic workbooks read from right to left. The accounts are provisional, and the allocation assumptions are described in the [documents](documents/index.qmd).

| Workbook | Content | Download |
|:-----------|:------------------------------------------|:---------------|
| **Physical energy flow accounts (PEFA), 2015 to 2022** | Supply and use tables of energy by industry and for households, in terajoules, for each year; the same tables by ISIC section; a long table of all years; indicators of energy use and intensity. | [English](https://github.com/renatovargas/tun-pefa-aea/raw/main/data/outputs/accounts/en/pefa-accounts-en.xlsx){.btn .btn-sm .btn-primary download="pefa-accounts-en.xlsx"} [Français](https://github.com/renatovargas/tun-pefa-aea/raw/main/data/outputs/accounts/fr/pefa-accounts-fr.xlsx){.btn .btn-sm .btn-outline-primary download="pefa-accounts-fr.xlsx"} [العربية](https://github.com/renatovargas/tun-pefa-aea/raw/main/data/outputs/accounts/ar/pefa-accounts-ar.xlsx){.btn .btn-sm .btn-outline-primary download="pefa-accounts-ar.xlsx"} |
| **Air emissions accounts (AEA), 2015 to 2022** | Greenhouse gas emissions by industry, households and gas, in kilotonnes of CO2 equivalent; the bridge table to the national inventory; emissions by inventory category and activity; emission intensities. | [English](https://github.com/renatovargas/tun-pefa-aea/raw/main/data/outputs/accounts/en/aea-accounts-en.xlsx){.btn .btn-sm .btn-primary download="aea-accounts-en.xlsx"} [Français](https://github.com/renatovargas/tun-pefa-aea/raw/main/data/outputs/accounts/fr/aea-accounts-fr.xlsx){.btn .btn-sm .btn-outline-primary download="aea-accounts-fr.xlsx"} [العربية](https://github.com/renatovargas/tun-pefa-aea/raw/main/data/outputs/accounts/ar/aea-accounts-ar.xlsx){.btn .btn-sm .btn-outline-primary download="aea-accounts-ar.xlsx"} |
